checklist.title: The intake should answer four questions.

items.title: Who is the buyer?
items.text: Agency, prime, subcontractor, or internal public-sector team.

items.title: What is the wedge?
items.text: Pilot, proposal support, workflow automation, or internal tool.

items.title: What is the timing?
items.text: Active pursuit, early capture, or exploratory planning.

items.title: What must happen next?
items.text: Discovery call, scope draft, technical narrative, or build plan.
